title: Jag Mohan Lal v. State of U.P.
coram: Munishwar Nath Bhandari, J.; Ajay Bhanot, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed as withdrawn; liberty to complain under Clause 6.5.
headnote: Writ petition dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty to file a complaint under paragraph 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005. The Court did not decide the underlying electricity dispute.
facts: Jag Mohan Lal filed a writ petition in the Allahabad High Court against the State of U.P. and four others. On 2 September 2020 a Division Bench granted three days to serve notice on respondents 2 and 3 and listed the matter as a fresh case for 9 September 2020. On that date, after hearing counsel for the petitioner and for respondent no. 2, the petitioner sought withdrawal of the writ with liberty to file a complaint under paragraph 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

holding_units.topic: liberty to complain under clause 6.5 on withdrawal
holding_units.holding: The writ petition was dismissed as withdrawn, with liberty to the petitioner to file a complaint under paragraph 6.5 of the Uttar Pradesh Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: The petitioner withdrew the writ and was granted liberty to pursue a complaint under paragraph 6.5 of the Supply Code rather than pressing the High Court petition.

not_decided.point: Merits of the petitioner's electricity grievance and of any Clause 6.5 complaint
not_decided.note: The Court dismissed the writ as withdrawn and did not examine the underlying dispute.
